app.name: Roshni
app.tagline: Your Guide in a Colorful World

home.uploadSubtitle: Detect colors and see the world in a better way
home.testSubtitle: A quick screening to check your color vision
home.didYouKnowBody: About 1 in 12 men and 1 in 200 women worldwide have some form of color vision deficiency. Roshni helps bridge that gap.

upload.title: Upload Image
upload.dropHint: Select any image to detect its colors
upload.cameraDenied: Camera access is needed to take a photo. You can allow it in your phone settings.
upload.error: Could not read this image. Please try another photo.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Photos you analyse will appear here.
history.deleteBody: It will be removed from your history.
history.clearBody: All items will be removed. Your favorites are kept.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.emptyBody: Save your color detection results using the heart button to find them here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Welcome to Roshni
profile.aboutBody: Roshni helps people with color vision deficiency identify colors, preview how images look under different vision types, and hear color names spoken aloud.
profile.restartNote: Restart the app to apply the new text direction.
profile.disclaimer: Roshni is an assistive tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose any condition. Do not rely on it for traffic signals, electrical wiring or medication. If you are concerned about your vision, please see an eye-care professional.
profile.speakOnTap: Speak the color when I tap the photo

voiceCheck.title: Voice check
voiceCheck.intro: Checks which text-to-speech voices this phone has installed.
voiceCheck.urduMissing: No Urdu voice found on this phone
voiceCheck.englishSample: The image contains dark red, pale yellow and teal.
voiceCheck.urduSample: تصویر میں گہرا سرخ، ہلکا پیلا اور سبز نیلا رنگ ہے۔

result.title: Result
result.tapHint: Pinch to zoom. Tap the photo to name any point.
result.empty: No colors could be detected in this image.
result.noUrdu: This phone has no Urdu voice. Install one in Settings > Text-to-speech, or switch Roshni to English to hear color names.
result.photoLabel: Photo. Pinch to zoom, tap to name a color.

disclaimer.short: Roshni is an assistive tool, not a medical device. Do not rely on it for traffic signals, wiring or medication.
disclaimer.title: Before you start

onboarding.languageBody: You can change this later in Profile.
onboarding.permissionsBody: Roshni asks for the camera or your photos only when you tap a button that needs them. Photos are analysed on your phone and are never uploaded.

camera.title: Live Camera
camera.hint: Point at an object. The color at the circle is named.
camera.permissionBody: Allow camera access to name colors live.

simulate.title: Color Blind Modes
simulate.choosePhotoBody: Pick a photo to see how it looks with each type of color blindness.
simulate.caption: Simulations are approximations of how people with each type may see colors. Real vision varies.
simulate.protanDesc: Red-blind: reds look dark, red and green blend
simulate.deutanDesc: Green-blind: green and red blend together
simulate.tritanDesc: Blue-blind: blue and green blend together
simulate.achromatDesc: No color: shades of grey only
simulate.splitHint: Left: original. Right: simulated. Drag the line.

test.title: Color Vision Test
test.intro: Spot the number hidden in each circle of dots. It takes about two minutes.
test.tips: For a fair result: use a bright screen, turn off night mode and blue-light filters, wear your glasses if you use them, and sit in good light.
test.notDiagnosis: This is a quick screening game, not a medical test. It cannot diagnose anything.
test.question: Which number do you see?

typical.title: No difficulty spotted
typical.body: You read these plates the way most people with typical colour vision do.

red-green.title: Possible red-green difficulty
red-green.body: You had trouble with several red-green plates. This can be a sign of a red-green colour vision difference, which is common and usually lifelong.

blue-yellow.title: Possible blue-yellow difficulty
blue-yellow.body: You had trouble with the blue-yellow plates.

both.title: Possible colour difficulty
both.body: You had trouble with several plates.

retake.title: Let's try again
retake.body: You could not read the practice plate, which anyone should. Check your screen brightness and lighting, then take the test again.

test.nextStepsBody: A screening on a phone can be wrong. For a proper answer, ask an eye specialist for a colour vision test. Roshni's camera and simulation tools work whatever your result is.

correct.title: Color Correction
correct.experimentalNote: This is an early feature that shifts colours to make them easier to tell apart. It has not yet been tested with colour-blind people, so it may help some photos and not others.
correct.choosePhotoBody: Pick a photo and we will adjust its colors to be easier to tell apart.
correct.notSure: Not sure which? Take the Color Vision Test first, or try each one and keep what looks clearest.
correct.splitHint: Left: original. Right: corrected. Drag the line.
correct.caption: Corrected colours are not the true colours of the photo. They are shifted so differences are easier to see. Do not rely on them for safety-critical decisions.
